senses.gloss:
mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous to cast or throw.
E.
कृ to throw, desiderative form उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desiring or intending to cut or cut off.
E.
वृत to cut, desiderative form, उ aff.

m. (-कः)
A physician, a practiser in medicine.
E.
कित, to cure, affix ण्वुल्, and the root reiterated.

n. (-नं)
Healing, practising medicine.
E.
कित to relieve, reiterative form, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-त्सा)
The practice of medicine, healing, curing, administering or applying remedies.
E.
कित to relieve, (disease,) in the reduplicate form, affixes अ and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Remedied, healed, physicked, cured.
n. (-तं)
Healing, remedying.
E.
कित, &c.: see the preceding, affix क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Flat-nosed.
E.
नि preposition, इनच् affix in this sense, and नि changed to चिक्.

m. (-लः)
Mud, mire.
E.
चिक to obstruct, इलच् affix deriv. irr.

mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षती-र्षत्)
Wishing, purposing, meaning to do.
E.
कृ to do, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

f. (-र्षा)
Desire to do any thing.
E.
कृ to do, in the desiderative form, अ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wished, designed, purposed.
n. (-तं)
Purpose, intention.
E.
कृ to do, desiderative form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु)
Desirous to do any thing.
E.
कृ to do, reiterated, and उ aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Rashly criminal, inconsiderately guilty, punishing or injuring others without consideration.
m. (-रः)
1 Hair.
2 A mountain.
2 A snake.
4 A musk rat.
5 A kind of bird.
6 A kind of tree.
E.
चि imitative sound, and कुर to utter, affix क.

m. (-रः)
Hair.
E.
see चिकुर; the vowel made long.

m. (-शः)
Abundance of hair.
E.
पाश affix in this sense: see कचपाश; also with other affixes चिकुरपक्ष, and चिकुरहस्त.

r. 10th cl. (चिक्कयति)
To give pain.

mfn. (-क्कः-क्की-क्कं)
Flat-nosed.
m. (-क्कः)
A musk rat.
f. (-क्का)
A mouse.
E.
चिक् imitative sound, and क who utters, from कै with ड affix; or चिक्क to give pain, and क affix; or in the last sense, नि preposition changed to चिक्, and कच् added.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (चीकति चीकयति)
1 To be patient, to suffer or endure.
2 To be impatient.
3 To touch.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Unctuous, greasy.
2 Bland, emollient.
3 Smooth, glossy.
4 Slippery.
m. (-णः)
The betel-nut tree.
nf. (-णं-णा or णी)
1 The betel-nut.
2 A good cow.
E.
चित to think of, Uṇādi affix कन्, the final of the radical changed to क.

f. (-ता)
Smoothness, greasiness, oiliness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, चिक्कणत्वं.

m. (-सः)
Barley meal.
E.
चिक्क to give pain, असच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Unctuous, greasy.
2 Bland, emollient.
3 Glossy, shining, smooth.
4 Slippery.
f. (-णा)
An excellent cow: see चिक्कण.

f. (-सा)
Wish to go or to approach.
E.
क्रम to go, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-दं)
Moisture, freshness.
E.
क्लिद to be wet, क affix, root redup.
